source.adqlQuery:
SELECT TOP 80000
  source_id,
  ra,
  dec,
  phot_g_mean_mag,
  bp_rp
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
  AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC, source_id ASC

fields.ra: ICRS right ascension in degrees at reference epoch J2016.0
fields.dec: ICRS declination in degrees at reference epoch J2016.0
fields.phot_g_mean_mag: Mean Gaia G-band magnitude on the Vega scale

source.selection: The first 80,000 Gaia DR3 sources with finite RA, Dec, mean G magnitude, and BP-RP colour after sorting by ascending G magnitude and then source_id.
source.completenessCaveat: This is a rendering-oriented Gaia subset, not a complete traditional bright-star catalogue. Gaia DR3 omits or lacks complete BP/RP photometry for some of the brightest naked-eye stars, so familiar objects such as Sirius are not guaranteed to be present. No synthetic or random stars are stored in this file.
